point_context:
### Another Voice: The reader who sees the feed narrowing

Each time I scroll, I see familiar arguments and sources. I begin to wonder about stories outside that circle. I want to know why one article comes before another, but I cannot see all the signals behind the order or switch the system off. Clicks, likes, shares, and search history can shape what appears. The service may also be tuned for engagement and advertising income. That makes me uneasy. A hidden order may be choosing what I notice first. I want to protect my chance to meet views I would not normally open.
